name: Betaseron
indications_original: BETASERON is indicated for the treatment of relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (MS), to include clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, in adults.
contraindications_original: • For subcutaneous use only ( 2.1 ) • The recommended dose is 0.25 mg every other day. Generally, start at 0.0625 mg (0.25 mL) every other day, and increase over a six-week period to 0.25 mg (1 mL) every other day. ( 2.1 ) • Reconstitute lyophilized powder with supplied diluent ( 2.2 )
adverseReactions_original: BETASERON is contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity to natural or recombinant interferon beta, Albumin (Human), or any other component of the formulation.
